fields.description: Issue features editorials and reporting on alleged municipal graft and vice enforcement in Miami, including discussion of anonymous letters accusing officials and calls for grand jury action; coverage of Gov. Fuller Warren’s retention of Sheriff Jimmy Sullivan; controversy over enforcement of bar/club closing hours; criticism of the Miami Traffic Board and Florida East Coast Railway negotiations; local civic issues including a proposed municipal golf course swap involving Miami Springs; municipal court activity and police-related cases; commentary on emergency medical response and a disputed physician bill; and community items such as the Royal Poinciana Festival and local nightlife/entertainment listings and advertisements.
